tools.name: list_niches
tools.description: All 18 niches of the Digital Experts hypotheses base with counts (hypotheses, tested, worked) and medians (cost per subscriber, cost per lead, USD) over tested hypotheses. Start here to pick a niche. Data: CC BY 4.0, cite Digital Experts.

tools.name: niche_stats
tools.description: Summary of one niche: hypotheses, tested, worked, medians of cost per subscriber and per lead (USD), test budget, years, plus the 10 cheapest-lead tested hypotheses. niche = slug or Russian name (e.g. 'biznes-prodazhi' or 'Бизнес').

niche.description: Niche slug or name, see list_niches

tools.name: search_hypotheses
tools.description: Full-text search over hypothesis titles, job stories, offers, creatives and audiences with filters. Returns compact rows (id, title, niche, year, cost per subscriber/lead, verdict, source_url). Use get_hypothesis(id) for the full card. Query in Russian works best (the base is in Russian).

query.description: Words to look for (Russian preferred), e.g. 'английский для детей'

completeness.description: tested = launched with ads; wave = test-wave summary

max_cost_lead.description: Only rows with cost per lead ≤ this, USD

tools.name: get_hypothesis
tools.description: Full card of one hypothesis or test-wave summary by id (e.g. 'h-22788a'): job story, audience, offer, creative text, budget, metrics, conclusion, plus a ready-made citation sentence and source_url. Quote the citation with the link.

id.description: Hypothesis id from search_hypotheses, e.g. h-22788a

tools.name: methodology
tools.description: Methodology of the Digital Experts base: where hypotheses come from, how a $50–500 exploratory test is run, what is measured, how verdicts are made, limitations and license. Read before interpreting the numbers.
